Working closely with leaders across a varied and complex organisation, you will provide trusted HR advice and take ownership of a broad portfolio of Employee Relations matters from initial assessment through to resolution.

You will be an experienced HR Business Partner, Employee Relations Specialist or Senior HR Advisor with the confidence to manage complex matters and provide sound, practical advice to leaders.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex Employee Relations matters
  • Strong investigation, writing and documentation skills

This is a great opportunity to join an established global organisation and experienced HR team where you will have the autonomy to manage your work, while being supported by a collaborative and down-to-earth team.

job.title: Service Technician Supervisor
job.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
Our client is an established Australian provider of critical engineered equipment and technical field support services, working across commercial and industrial customer sites. The business has a strong focus on safe work practices, high service standards, and developing skilled technicians through training and ongoing support.

ABOUT THE ROLE
This position leads the day-to-day coordination and performance of a field-based service team delivering installation, servicing, repairs, and urgent response work across customer locations. Reporting into the Service Manager, you’ll be the escalation point for complex technical issues and customer concerns, while keeping scheduling, documentation, and team standards running smoothly in a high-pressure environment.

DUTIES
• Lead, coach and hold standards for a field service team (including contractors as required), building trust and capability through regular check-ins, on-the-job guidance, performance management, and ensuring the team consistently represents the business professionally on customer sites
• Own job allocation end-to-end: plan the weekly workload, triage urgent callouts, reshuffle schedules in real time when conditions change, and maintain clear communication with technicians, admin and customers so expectations are set and met under tight timeframes
• Be the senior point of support for technical problem solving and customer escalations: assist with diagnosis and decision-making when jobs become complex, attend critical works when needed, and drive practical outcomes that protect service quality and customer relationships
• Drive safe delivery and compliance discipline across all works: reinforce PPE and site safety behaviour, ensure risk controls and required paperwork are completed correctly (pre-starts, job safety documentation, service records), and support incident/quality investigations and corrective actions where required
• Lift operational performance: monitor productivity and utilisation, identify recurring issues and bottlenecks, coordinate parts/tools/vehicles so work can be executed efficiently, and improve reporting accuracy and workflow discipline to strengthen customer outcomes and reduce rework

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
• Proven experience leading a trade / technical / service team in a customer-facing, field-based environment where priorities shift quickly; you’re confident balancing multiple moving jobs and keeping people aligned when pressure is high
• Strong coordination and communication capability (written + verbal): you can run a busy schedule, provide clear direction, keep stakeholders updated, and ensure technicians complete accurate job notes and reporting without constant chasing
• High mechanical aptitude is essential (trade qualification preferred but not mandatory if the hands-on technical understanding is there); you can guide fault-finding and support technicians during difficult situations
• Calm, resilient, and emotionally switched-on leadership style: you can have professional, direct conversations with technicians and customers during escalations, show empathy without losing standards
• Comfortable with a role that includes both office-based coordination and time in the field (often on customer sites), plus occasional after-hours contact for true emergencies, this suits someone who enjoys responsibility, variety, and being the person others rely on to stabilise the day

BENEFITS
• Competitive salary package + fully maintained tool of trade vehicle
• Autonomous leadership role with real impact across service delivery, customer outcomes, and technician performance
• Strong internal support from the service leadership team and access to training for technical and safety capability uplift
• Stable, long-term opportunity within a business investing in service standards and team development

job.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY
A leading Australian provider of sterilisation and decontamination services, supporting industries including healthcare, medical, agriculture, and quarantine with advanced processing solutions. With over 40 years of industry expertise, the business is recognised for its innovation, technical capability, and commitment to delivering safe, high-quality outcomes for customers across Australia and globally. 

ABOUT THE ROLE
A newly created Maintenance Manager position, responsible for end-to-end maintenance across a critical industrial processing site in Mickleham (on-site). This is a hands-on, stand-alone role to start with an opportunity to build a team over time, reporting directly to the General Manager and supporting safe, reliable, compliant operations.

DUTIES
• Own the site’s maintenance function end-to-end (hands-on): plan and execute preventative and reactive maintenance across plant, equipment and site infrastructure, troubleshoot breakdowns, coordinate repairs, and drive uptime improvements in a safety-critical environment
• Build and run a practical maintenance system: establish maintenance schedules, critical spares, work order discipline, service records, contractor management, and clear routines that reduce downtime and improve reliability (without overcomplicating things)
• Lead compliance and risk controls for maintenance activities: ensure maintenance practices meet safety and environmental requirements, manage permits/isolations/LOTO expectations, and keep documentation and standards audit-ready in partnership with internal stakeholders
• Partner with operations to lift performance: work closely with production/operations leaders to prioritise work, plan shutdown windows, identify recurring issues, and implement continuous improvements that improve throughput, safety, and cost control

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
• Trade-backed maintenance capability (highly desirable): mechanical fitting/turning (or closely aligned) with strong practical troubleshooting skills across industrial equipment and systems
• Proven maintenance leadership in a site-based environment: experience running maintenance in manufacturing / processing / industrial settings, including planning, preventative maintenance programs, contractor coordination, and pragmatic prioritisation under pressure
• Strong safety and compliance mindset: demonstrated ability to manage maintenance risk (isolations / LOTO, safe systems of work, contractor safety, documentation) and operate effectively in regulated, safety-first workplaces
• Commercial and operational thinking: able to balance uptime, cost, quality and risk; confident communicating with senior stakeholders, reporting on maintenance performance, and building a case for improvements, spares, and future resourcing

COMPANY CULTURE
This is a family-owned, proudly Australian organisation where integrity, commitment, and genuine care for people are central to how they operate. The culture is strongly aligned to safety, quality, innovation and continuous improvement, with a focus on delivering excellent service while maintaining a safe, supportive work environment. 

BENEFITS
• Newly created role with real autonomy to set the maintenance standard and make visible, site-wide impact
• Permanent, full-time position on-site in Mickleham, reporting directly to the General Manager
• Competitive salary on offer, based on experience
• Future growth runway as the function develops, with scope to add resources over time

job.title: Product Management and PLM Enablement Lead
job.description:
The Company
 
A growing business, this ISO accredited company manufactures and supplies a wide range of high-quality engineered industrial products to a variety of industries for use in the industrial, infrastructure and domestic markets. With an ever-expanding footprint, to support the company’s growth, they are in the market to appoint an experienced Product Management and PLM Lead.
 
 
The Role
 
As the subject matter expert in product management, the role exists to build the capability of the Product Managers across the full Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) process, from opportunity assessment and discovery, through product launch, into performance management, improvement and, ultimately, retirement. Key Responsibilities include:
 
Capability Development
  • Design and deliver a structured Product Management curriculum across the full PLM lifecycle
  • Facilitate workshops, coaching, onboarding, and refresher training
  • Develop practical learning resources, templates, and product-based case studies
 
Product Management Coaching
  • Mentor Product Managers through discovery, business cases, roadmaps, and product launches
  • Provide coaching, peer reviews, and constructive feedback to strengthen capability
  • Support Product Managers through key lifecycle gates as a trusted advisor
 
PLM Tools & Standards
  • Develop and maintain PLM playbooks, templates, checklists, and business case frameworks
  • Establish consistent product management standards, governance processes, and quality benchmarks
  • Maintain a central library of PLM resources and best practices
 
Continuous Improvement
  • Lead the Product Management Community of Practice to encourage knowledge sharing and collaboration
  • Capture lessons learned and incorporate improvements into PLM frameworks and tools
  • Benchmark industry best practices to continuously enhance Product Management capability and processes
 
 
The Person
 
You will have extensive product management experience across the full product lifecycle, in addition to expertise in launching and managing products, developing product management capability through coaching and mentoring, and creating practical PLM frameworks, tools, and standards.
 
With a tertiary qualification in business, engineering, marketing, or a related discipline. An MBA and recognised product management certification are desirable. You will also have strong commercial acumen and knowledge of product strategy, market analysis, business cases, and go-to-market planning.
